Frequently asked questions

Answers to help you move forward.

How can I get started?

Complete the form or contact UrbanGO. Tell us whether you have a vehicle and explain your situation; our team will reply with the relevant steps.

Do I need my own vehicle?

Not necessarily. UrbanGO offers TVDE vehicle solutions, subject to availability and terms confirmed by our team.

Which documents are required?

Documents depend on your situation. To avoid outdated legal information, see the requirements page and confirm your case with our team.

How soon can I start?

Timing depends on profile validation, documents and vehicle availability where applicable. UrbanGO confirms the timing for each request.

How can I get in touch?

Use the form, call +351 910 128 228 or email geral@urbango.pt.
